name: 🍌 Banana Egg Pancakes
tagline: Three-ingredient pancakes: banana, eggs and oats. Naturally sweet, high in protein.

steps.text: Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt until smooth. Let it sit 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a nonstick skillet or griddle over medium-low with a little butter.
Pour small pancakes (about 3 inches). They're delicate, so keep them small.
Drop a few berries on each. Cook until the edges look set and bubbles appear, then flip.
Serve with a spoon of vanilla yogurt and a drizzle of syrup.

kid_jobs.job: Peel and break up the bananas
Set the table with yogurt and syrup

chef_tip: The oats and a 5-minute rest give the batter body, so the pancakes flip like real pancakes instead of falling apart.
make_ahead: Cook, cool and freeze flat; toast from frozen on school mornings.
leftovers: Good cold with peanut butter as a snack.
swaps: Add a scoop of cottage cheese for even more protein
Chocolate chips for a treat day
heads_up: Spotty, very ripe bananas work best.
